description: Staff Software Engineer - PJ (Business Customers) About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and beyond — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. We combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. You will join PJ Brazil , Nubank’s business-customers unit, in the area we call Enterprises . This group builds solutions for customers who are companies (legal entities), focusing on the everyday operational and bureaucratic tasks that consume their time — such as issuing invoices, paying taxes and automating collections — so they can focus on what actually generates revenue. As a Staff Software Engineer – PJ , you will work cross-team across multiple squads in Enterprises (around five teams, ~35 people), acting as a senior technical leader and hands‑on engineer. You will own reference architectures and guide several teams toward them, while still being close to the code and day‑to‑day engineering decisions. The role was originally scoped at IC8 and is now an IC7 opportunity, intentionally designed to give space for growth in scope and impact over time. You’ll be responsible for Leading architecture across multiple PJ squads , defining reference architectures and guiding teams in their adoption for products such as collections assistants, tax payers and invoice issuance flows. Acting as a cross-team technical leader in the Enterprises area, working with several teams at once rather than a single squad, and influencing how we design systems end-to-end for business customers. Staying hands‑on in the code , pairing with engineers, reviewing designs and implementations, and helping to solve complex technical problems in our PJ product stack. Collaborating closely with product managers and senior stakeholders , especially in PJ, to align technical direction with business strategy and the evolving needs of business customers. Helping teams design reliable, observable and maintainable systems for mission‑critical business workflows (e.g., collections, tax payments, invoices), ensuring good instrumentation and operability. Mentoring senior engineers (IC5/IC6), helping them grow into broader cross‑team influence and stronger architectural leadership. We are looking for a person who has Required Solid experience as a Staff-level engineer (IC7 or equivalent) , with deep technical expertise and a strong track record of impact. Experience designing and evolving complex backend systems and architectures, preferably across multiple squads or domains. Proven ability to act as a cross-team technical leader , influencing several teams at once and collaborating with senior stakeholders. Strong stakeholder‑management skills , including experience working with senior product and business leaders, negotiating priorities and driving alignment. A hands‑on mindset : despite seniority and cross‑scope, you still enjoy and regularly engage in technical work (architecture, coding, reviews, debugging). Based in Brazil , with full professional fluency in Portuguese; this role is focused on PJ Brazil and day‑to‑day collaboration happens primarily in Portuguese. Nice to have Experience building products for companies (business customers) — e.g., B2B or SMB tools, billing, invoicing, collections, tax, ERPs, or similar. Familiarity with collections / billing / tax / invoicing domains and their operational complexity. title: Subsea Engineer
description: Purpose To ensure that the offshore subsea equipment spread is operated and maintained in an efficient, organised, and controlled manner in accordance with manufacturer operating manuals and project procedures. Carry out engineering duties within the back deck / subsea department, supporting the subsea team under the direction of the senior subsea lead. Develop technical knowledge and operational awareness to become fully conversant with the senior subsea engineer role. Operate as part of the vessel crew and work under the overall authority of the Vessel Master in line with vessel command structure. Duties & Responsibilities The Subsea Engineer shall: Uphold project safety and environmental policies and ensure defects, incidents, near misses, and non-conformances are reported and investigated in line with applicable procedures. Ensure that subsea personnel and technicians work in accordance with safe systems of work, including risk assessments and control measures prior to task execution. Support supervision and coordination of subsea department personnel, maintaining discipline and compliance with applicable maritime codes of conduct. Participate in vessel emergency response duties and drills as per the Muster List. Assist with inspection, testing, and basic maintenance of vessel safety systems, including fire detection and alarm systems where required. Take responsibility for safe and efficient operation of subsea systems when acting in a supervisory capacity or in the absence of the senior subsea lead. Demonstrate full understanding of senior subsea engineer responsibilities, including launch and recovery of subsea assets and operational decision-making offshore. Ensure subsea systems are operated within approved operational and insurance limitations. Manage subsea systems during maintenance, refurbishment, or standby periods. Coordinate subsea team activities including work allocation and watchkeeping in supervisory scenarios. Support planning and execution of maintenance, repair, and overhaul of subsea equipment to ensure operational readiness at all times. Escalate system downtime or reduced functionality to vessel leadership and onshore management where required. Assist with reporting, documentation, and technical returns for subsea systems. Maintain awareness of operational factors including vessel manoeuvrability, weather conditions, currents, and seabed characteristics. Support training and development of junior technicians and subsea personnel. Undertake additional duties within the subsea engineering discipline as required by vessel or project management. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Wij gaan altijd een stapje verder. Voor onze klanten en vooral ook voor jou. Zodat jij de allerbeste werkomgeving hebt, die inclusief is en waar we flink bezig zijn met duurzaamheid. title: Wayfinding and Signage Manager
description: Wayfinding and Signage Manager Department: Technical & Infrastructure Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Wayfinding and Signage Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Wayfinding and Signage Manager is responsible for leading the wayfinding and signage implementation, operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class wayfinding and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027, ensuring that the wayfinding and signage is up to FIFA quality standards. They will be initially responsible for the technical development of wayfinding signage guidelines and principles in collaboration with the contracted provider(s), department senior team and the other Cluster Managers. Subsequently, the candidate will be responsible for directly overseeing the wayfinding signage planning and implementation at stadiums and other official sites. In all aspects of their role, they will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations, ensuring that they are managed efficiently while monitoring budgetary spend within agreed limits. In addition, they will take guidance from other cluster managers to ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Contributing to the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027. Providing expertise in assisting in the compilation of technical wayfinding signage guidelines, principles and templates. Inputting into the development of the wayfinding signage system(s) used to assist with the planning of the project. Providing strategic input into the development and implementation of the wayfinding signage kit of parts to be utilized at all official sites. Overseeing the wayfinding signage planning and implementation at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 stadiums in Brazil. Working with other Cluster Managers ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all sites within the sites. Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of allocated wayfinding operations and reporting updates to senior department members. Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaising with site owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Attending department‑specific and organization site visits at both assigned sites and potentially additional official sites. Acting as the main wayfinding point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers during the implementation phase of the project. Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against. Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. YOUR PROFILE Relevant experience in delivering wayfinding and signage projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. and experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive wayfinding and signage related activities. Experience in devising technical guidelines and wayfinding signage kit of parts for large‑scale events. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) Strong understanding of stadium wayfinding and signage requirements and large‑scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi‑fased events and projects. Experience in managing providers of services for world‑class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organisations and departments. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education). Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on‑site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written) Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Develop and execute the national sales strategy to achieve revenue, profitability, and market share objectives for the company's non-dairy whipped cream product portfolio. Lead, coach, and develop a national B2B sales team to consistently achieve sales targets and expand market coverage. Build and maintain strong relationships with key accounts including food manufacturers, commercial bakeries, bakery chains, cake manufacturers, dessert manufacturers, foodservice operators, HORECA customers, and distributors. Identify new business opportunities across the bakery, confectionery, dessert, cafe, foodservice, and industrial food manufacturing sectors. Lead commercial negotiations for strategic supply agreements, pricing, contract renewals, and long‑term customer partnerships. Collaborate with technical application and R&D teams to develop customer‑specific product solutions and support new product development initiatives. Provide technical and commercial guidance to customers on product applications, product performance, and formulation solutions for non-dairy whipped cream products. Analyze market trends, customer demand, competitive activities, and emerging consumer trends to identify growth opportunities. Develop sales forecasts, budgets, pipeline reports, and performance metrics to support business planning. Monitor sales performance, profitability, pricing strategies, and customer profitability to maximize commercial results. Represent the company at industry exhibitions, trade shows, customer visits, product demonstrations, and technical seminars to strengthen market presence. Work closely with operations and supply chain teams to ensure product availability, inventory planning, and customer service excellence. Drive CRM adoption and maintain accurate sales forecasting, customer activity tracking, and pipeline management. REQUIREMENTS Bare minimum 10 - 15 years of food ingredient sales experience, with at least 3 recent years specifically in the non-dairy whipped cream segment. 5+ years of experience leading regional or national sales teams in Brazil/South America. Must possess deep relationships with food manufacturing, commercial bakeries, cafes, dessert, and HORECA space for Brazil. Strong understanding of non-dairy whipped cream applications, product functionality, whipping performance, stability, shelf life, and end‑user requirements. Experience managing complex B2B sales cycles, key account management, distributor networks, and commercial contract negotiations. Ability to identify market opportunities and develop effective go‑to‑market strategies for specialized food products. Strong professional working fluency in English, and fluency in Portuguese is REQUIRED. Willingness to travel frequently to support customers, distributors, and sales teams. Bachelor's degree in Business, Food Science, Food Technology, Marketing, or a related discipline is preferred. If you are qualified and interested, we kindly invite you to apply! #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: CPY REP WAG Manifolds
description: The Service Provider will liaise with CPY Subsea HSE Lead, CPY Delivery Lead, CPY Materials & Welding Lead and CPY Quality Lead. HSE and Compliance Fully comply with site security, health and safety instructions, stay vigilant and maintain continuous awareness of hazards and surroundings. Ensure that HSE contractual requirements and the implementation/compliance to HSE documentation are duly applied by CTR and Sub-CTRs, through the day‑to‑day supervision and by making Company REP presence visible on site. Will be accountable for demonstrating, individually, an exemplary behaviour regarding H3SE rules & requirements, including trainings, and enforcing HSE execution decisions/directions taken by CPY Subsea HSE Lead. Report any issue/anomalies (using system in place in the facility) and make use of TOTAL STOP WORK policy as necessary. Ensure that risk assessments are performed as and when necessary, that management of change is adhered to and that tool‑box talks are conducted efficiently. Adopt and demonstrate exemplary behaviour regarding Company Ethics and "Code of Conduct" policy and promote the re‑enforcement of the Anti‑Corruption Program. WORK TASKS The Service holder will be responsible to control that the work performed by CTR and sub‑CTR is in line with CPY and Project Specifications for WAG Manifolds and Foundations. The activities contemplated will depend on the nature of the work to be controlled, but will include document/certificates review, NDE and NDT tasks (and DT, in case of investigation) of various techniques, dimensional control, cleanliness control, and all tests conducted in general. Duties will include but not be limited to: Ensure that timely notification has been issued, 3rd party and/or COMPANY personnel and/or COMPANY other contractors are mobilized (if there is such a requirement). Ensure that the personnel in charge of performing the task is certified and has been trained adequately. Ensure that the equipment to be controlled is at an adequate state of completion (in line with ITP) to start the task. Ensure that corresponding procedures have been approved, available on the control area, read and fully understood by the person(s) in charge to conduct the control operation. Ensure that all equipment/tools to be used during the control program are in good working order and certified (for those where such requirement exists). Ensure that all consumables to be used during the control program are adequate, quality and quantity wise. Ensure that all necessary JRA and TBT have been conducted before commencing the work. Ensure that the work area is controlled (barriers in place for pressure testing or lifting equipment for instance) and that personnel working in adjacent areas is fully aware of the nature of the task to be performed and its associated risks. Witness and ensure that control program steps are strictly followed and recorded (pictures, paper charts, electronic files …). Sign off the control document during execution of the program, as and where required. Report and log any non‑conformity. Stop the work in case of non‑conformity and re‑assess the situation before resuming. Discuss with contractor/sub‑contractors in case of issues/unconformity during the control program to look for acceptable solutions in order not to penalise the delivery schedule but still fulfilling the quality standards set by the contract. Ensure that unconformities are driven towards closure in a timely manner (i.e. without impacting the delivery schedule). Ensure that, following completion of the control program, the equipment is back to a state of readiness for starting the next step of the ITP. Participate to COMPANY and contractor audits and follow up closure of identified issues. Work closely with all involved parties to ensure correct information is transmitted and fully aligned. Issue weekly report to CPY stating status, look ahead, HSE and quality issues. The Service holder shall ensure the prompt issue of the dispatch dossier including all necessary certifications as well as the finalisation on time of the manufacturing record book associated with deliverables. The Service Provider will additionally assess and monitor the Welding and Welding Qualification Programs; assess and monitor the Testing Program ensuring equipment and tooling are fit for the intended purpose and conditions, with the technical assistance of the SPS discipline leaders; and monitor the impact of the qualification and testing program on the SPS schedule. Requirements Previous experience with WAG Manifolds and Subsea Structures. In-depth knowledge and experience of Testing regime across all phases (factory acceptance, integration, Stack‑Up and/or site receival). Knowledge/Experience of manufacturing sequences and relevant Quality regime. Degree and/or Master in Engineering and/or equivalent relevant professional experience. QC qualifications/certifications are a plus. Languages: Fluent in English (Spanish / French is a plus). Professional Experience: 20 years minimum. Experience within project/s: 15 years minimum. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Especialista Comercial - Hunter - RJ
description: Localização & Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido Nosso time de Marketplace trabalha com o modelo “híbrido”, sendo necessário estar disponível para eventuais reuniões presenciais com clientes na cidade duas vezes por mês. Etapas do Processo Seletivo Triagem People Interview Hiring Manager Interview Live Case Stakeholder Interview Offer Sobre a Área O Marketplace do QuintoAndar está em forte expansão pelo Brasil, e o sucesso desse movimento depende diretamente de conquistar as imobiliárias certas em cada praça . Para isso, estamos contratando Executivos(as) de Expansão — Hunters — que vão ser responsáveis por liderar o fechamento de parcerias com imobiliárias em sua praça de atuação. Esta é uma posição de frente de batalha : você vai pegar uma praça, conhecê‑la melhor do que ninguém, mapear quem importa, abrir portas com as imobiliárias mais estratégicas e fechar contratos que se traduzem em crescimento real para o negócio. Você terá apoio de um time de BDRs para gerar pipeline qualificado, mas o protagonismo da abordagem consultiva, da negociação e do fechamento é seu. Requisitos Experiência sólida em vendas B2B consultivas com foco em hunting e fechamento de novos clientes. Histórico comprovado de bater e superar metas. Perfil hunter de verdade: energia para abrir portas, resiliência para lidar com não e senso de urgência. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de argumentação , com facilidade para construir rapport com decisores sêniores e conduzir conversas com C-Level/donos de negócio. Habilidade de negociação consultiva , sabendo navegar objeções complexas, construir propostas ganha-ganha e fechar com disciplina comercial. Forte capacidade de mapeamento e leitura de mercado , identificando perfis com potencial de influência, engajamento e impacto na praça. Autonomia, organização e senso de dono. Domínio de CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive ou similar) e disciplina de pipeline/forecast. Disponibilidade para atuação em campo na praça sob sua responsabilidade. Diferenciais Vivência com imobiliárias, corretores de imóveis ou mercado imobiliário — ter rede e fluência no jargão do setor ajuda. Experiência em startups, scale-ups, proptechs ou marketplaces em fase de hipercrescimento. Familiaridade com metodologias estruturadas de venda. Conhecimento de funil de aquisição, testes de canal e experimentação comercial. Responsabilidades Ser dono(a) da praça sob sua responsabilidade: entender o mercado local, mapear as principais imobiliárias, identificar players de alta influência e priorizar contas com maior potencial de impacto. Liderar a prospecção ativa e o relacionamento com imobiliárias estratégicas, indo a campo quando necessário para construir confiança e destravar negócios. Conduzir todo o ciclo de venda consultiva: descoberta, demonstração de valor, construção de proposta, negociação de termos e fechamento do contrato de parceria. Bater (e superar) as metas individuais de fechamento de imobiliárias parceiras. Realizar abordagens consultivas com decisores (sócios, diretores, gestores), entendendo o contexto e as dores específicas de cada imobiliária e conectando‑as à proposta de valor do QuintoAndar. Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de BDRs no refinamento de pipeline, qualificação de oportunidades e priorização da carteira. Abrir portas em contas estratégicas onde a prospecção tradicional não basta — usando networking, eventos do setor, indicações e presença local como alavancas. Identificar e ativar perfis com potencial de influência, transformando parceiros em embaixadores e amplificadores na praça. Mapear continuamente o mercado da praça: clusters geográficos, perfis de imobiliária, movimentos da concorrência e oportunidades não óbvias. Construir relacionamento de longo prazo com decisores‑chave, mantendo proximidade mesmo após o fechamento para garantir engajamento e expansão da parceria. Testar novas estratégias de aquisição: canais, discursos, segmentações e formatos de oferta, capturando aprendizados que possam ser replicados em outras praças. Atuar como voz da praça internamente, trazendo insights de mercado para Produto, Marketing e Operações. Manter o pipeline rigorosamente atualizado no CRM, com forecast preciso e visibilidade clara da saúde dos deals. Acompanhar de perto seus indicadores de funil — taxa de conexão, conversão entre etapas, ciclo de venda, win rate, ticket médio — e usar esses números para ajustar a própria atuação. Contribuir para a construção de playbooks, pitches e melhores práticas que serão usados pelo time de Expansão como um todo. Colaborar com pares de outras praças, compartilhando aprendizados e elevando o nível do time. Importante O nosso processo seletivo começa na candidatura! Se você está realmente a fim de fazer parte do nosso time, foque nessa etapa do processo. Nós analisamos todos os candidatos individualmente e damos retorno para todas as pessoas que investiram tempo em se candidatar. Toda comunicação é feita por e-mail, então fique atento às nossas mensagens e libere o domínio @quintoandar.com.br para que nossos e-mails não sejam parar no spam. Benefícios Salário competitivo PLR - Participação nos Lucros e Resultados Remuneração variável (Somente para vagas comerciais) Vale Refeição e Alimentação Plano de saúde Plano odontológico Seguro de vida Auxílio creche e Auxílio parentalidade atípica Wellhub Auxílio home office QuintoCare: Nosso programa de apoio (saúde mental, assistência social, apoio jurídico e financeiro) Licença parental estendida Dia livre de aniversário, Dia das Mães e Dia dos Pais Clube de Benefícios (descontos em serviços do dia a dia) Descontos em instituições de ensino Kit leiturinha para crianças - Playkids Diversidade & Inclusão no Grupo QuintoAndar Valorizamos a diversidade e queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam bem‑vindo por aqui — independentemente da sua idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, cor, etnia, origem, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica. Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para todas as pessoas! Você verificará que existem algumas perguntas sobre diversidade no formulário de inscrição. Em vagas afirmativas, as informações poderão ser utilizadas para verificar o seu alinhamento com o público‑alvo da oportunidade, podendo, nesses casos, ter caráter eliminatório. Para vagas não afirmativas, esses dados serão utilizados de forma anonimizada, exclusivamente para acompanhar e aprimorar nossas práticas de inclusão nos processos seletivos e sem impacto na sua candidatura. Privacidade e Proteção a Dados O Grupo QuintoAndar atua em conformidade com as leis de privacidade e proteção de dados, incluindo, mas não se limitando à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais - LGPD (Lei nº 13.709/2018), e garante a segurança de seus dados pessoais. Para saber mais, acesse o nosso Aviso de Privacidade para Pessoas Candidatas. Se tiver dúvidas ou quiser exercer seus direitos como titular de dados, entre em contato com a gente pelo Canal de Atendimento. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Commercial Analyst, Gas and Power
description: ## Senior Commercial Analyst, Gas and PowerApplylocations: Rio De Janeiro, Braziltime type: Full timeposted on: Posted Todayjob requisition id: JR **Important!** To make sure your application is considered, please submit it before the end of the day on (dd.mm.yyyy): We encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.# What does the job involve?Strategy and Business Development is the business unit within Marketing, Midstream and Processing at Equinor which is accountable for business development activities in MMP across the full range of MMP existing and emerging/future commodities and products. For oil & gas development, acquisition, and divestment projects, SBD is accountable for coordinating all marketing and midstream deliverables, including commercial analysis, mid- and downstream architecture, MMP negotiated agreements, optimal commodity route to market, and value uplift. In Brazil, this unit has the responsibility to ensure flow assurance for equity gas, which includes originating gas and natural gas liquids sales transactions, negotiating access to infrastructure, and balancing and optimizing from production to market the Equinor domestic gas portfolio. By joining our team in Marketing, Midstream & Processing you will have the opportunity to: Be a key contributor to achieving the unit’s ambition of developing a Brazil market position to capture value and secure flow assurance of our upstream portfolio. The successful candidate will work across the business, and the position provides the opportunity to shape the direction of Equinor’s market position in Brazil. This position will contribute to the structuring, negotiation and execution of commercial transactions, and provide analytical insight to support business decisions, while also contributing to shaping Equinor’s market position in Brazil.# What will my tasks be?Within this position, your key tasks will be to:* Contribute to origination, structuring and execution of gas sales transactions and related agreements.* Contribute to negotiation of gas sales, infrastructure access and commercial contracts.* Develop pricing models and support financial and risk assessment of transactions.* Identify and analyze value drivers, risks and optionality in structured agreements.* Monitor regulatory developments and market trends in gas and power markets.* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders (trading, operations, legal, risk) to support deal execution.* Contribute to development of new commercial products and solutions.# Here's what we expect from you:At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for:* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business or equivalent.* 7+ years Relevant experience in Brazilian energy markets, preferably gas or power commercialization with experience in commercial analysis or business development / deal structuring roles.* Strong analytical, financial modelling and problem-solving skills preferably with a knowledge of relevant tools, programs and automation processes.* An interest and knowledge of AI tools and processes would be beneficial for future integration and projects.* Effective communication and stakeholder engagement.* Collaborative mindset with an ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing environments.* Fluency in Portuguese and English.# What can we offer you?We want you to have a rewarding and fulfilling work life. That’s why we offer:Not just a job - a careerIn Equinor, your development begins on day one. You will build your competence through a wide range of learning activities while being empowered to build your career across multiple disciplines and geographies. Our internal job market allows a wide range of opportunities for development and growth within your own field, or even in other areas you find interesting and relevant.Attractive rewardsWe give you a comprehensive benefits package with a competitive salary, global parental leave, bonus scheme and pension plan.Wellness and work-life balanceWe care about and prioritise our employees’ well-being. We know that for you to be the best version of yourself in the workplace, being able to collect your children, attend a class or simply enjoy social time can be invaluable. That’s why we encourage you to make use of our flexible work arrangements wherever possible.An inclusive cultureWe believe embracing our differences makes us stronger. For us, true inclusion means being able to bring your whole self to work, and for you and everyone else to feel accepted and valued.# Equal opportunities for everyoneEquinor is an equal-opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions, which include hiring, promotion, transfer, demotion, termination, and training, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or any other protected status.As part of this commitment, reasonable adjustments will be made during the recruitment process for candidates with disabilities or long-term health conditions. If you have any specific requirements, please clarify this in your application and our team will be in contact to see how we can support your needs. We also believe everyone should be paid fairly and consistently for their contribution to our collective success. To ensure fairness and transparency, positions at Equinor are evaluated using our global job architecture based on the position’s responsibilities, complexity, and impact, and regularly reviewed to ensure consistency and alignment across the organisation.# Important notes about the application processWe expect you to openly offer all relevant information about yourself during the recruitment process. Background checks are performed on all final candidates, and all permanent and temporary hires will be screened using relevant sanctions lists to ensure compliance with sanctions laws. The role operates with autonomy, owning problems end-to-end, making technical calls within its scope without waiting for direction, and knowing when to elevate versus move forward. Beyond execution, you will be a senior voice in the team's design discussions: architecture decisions, integration patterns with Identity Hub, ITSec/IAM/Datasec touchpoints, and the cross‑pack discussions with Coding Tools, AI Enablement, and Enterprise Solutions. Review the PM Defect Reports and evaluate corrective actions. Participate in developing, revising and tracking Asset Management strategies. title: MSF Access Regional Pharmacist America Hub
description: Job Title: MSF Access Regional Pharmacist America Hub Contract Type: Short-term contract Duration: 12 months Working Time: Full time Starting Date: ASAP Deadline to apply: July 10, 2026 Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Reporting to: Head of Americas Hub Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract. I. BACKGROUND MSF INTERNATIONA Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency medical assistance to people affected by conflict, epidemics, disasters, or exclusion from healthcare. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 27 associations and 18 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information, and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF ACCESS Access to Products for Healthcare is critical to MSF's Social Mission. It refers to the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness, and quality of products for healthcare for the populations MSF assists and their communities. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve Access in past decades through the work of MSF’s Access Campaign. In 2023, the MSF International Board approved the set-up of a new organisational model for Access work in MSF, building upon the works carried out by Access Campaign. MSF Access team is transitioned from this process and has the responsibility of analysing and developing initiatives to address technical and structural challenges in ensuring equitable access to quality assured, affordable, adaptive and appropriate medical tools needed in MSF settings and beyond. The newly established MSF Access structure replaces the former Access Campaign with a broader scope of work, operating through five strategic regional hubs: Dakar, Senegal: West and Central Africa. Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: The Americas. Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia: Asia and Oceania. Nairobi, Kenya: Eastern and Southern Africa. Brussels, Belgium: Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa. In MSF Access team’s strategic plan and the annual plan 2026, enhancing strategic approach towards evolving regulatory landscapes and their impact on access in MSF settings has been included as one priority area for analysis. In the Americas, local and regional production and innovation, combined with regulatory convergence and harmonization, are increasingly central to ensuring sustainable access to essential health products. At the same time, regulatory complexity, fragmented approval pathways and limited sourcing options continue to constrain MSF operations and public health systems. This position strengthens MSF Access’ regional capacity to analyse, influence and engage on production, innovation and regulatory agendas, ensuring they are explicitly oriented toward access and public health needs, including MSF operational priorities. II. PLACEMENT The Regional Pharmacist is part of the MSF Access Americas Hub and reports to the Head of the Americas Region. The position works in close collaboration with the Americas regional advisors and has a strong functional link with the Analysis Department of the MSF Access team, a multidisciplinary group of experts working on medical, pharmaceutical, legal and policy issues related to access to health products. III. OBJECTIVE OF THE POSITION The objective of the position is to strengthen MSF Access’ understanding of local and regional production in the Americas, with a particular focus on how regulatory frameworks, harmonization initiatives, reliance models, policies affecting the importation, exportation and regional circulation of health products, and mechanisms designed to incentivize local and regional production create opportunities or pose risks for equitable access to quality‑assured medicines, diagnostics and vaccines, including how regulation shapes markets and access, influences market dynamics through systemic barriers and enablers, and impacts equity and the availability of essential health products across countries in the region. Through in‑depth regulatory and policy analysis, the position aims to generate actionable evidence to inform MSF operations, advocacy and engagement on local production, regional supply strategies, pooled procurement and other collaborative purchasing mechanisms, as well as broader efforts to improve sustainable and equitable access to health technologies across the region. IV. MAIN ACTIVITIES Understand existing production, innovation and regulatory landscapes (diagnostic core) Monitor and analyse existing national and regional production and innovation initiatives related to medicines, vaccines and diagnostics, including developments concerning: Technology transfer and licensing initiatives Public and regional manufacturing capacity Regional collaboration and coordination platforms Funding mechanisms and industrial policy instruments Regulatory approval pathways, market authorization processes, importation and exportation frameworks, procurement mechanisms, and reliance/harmonization mechanisms, and their interaction with market structures, shaping both the feasibility of local and regional production and its impact on equitable access, including product availability, pricing, affordability, and supply security Conduct desk reviews and ongoing analysis of existing regional and national policies, strategies and initiatives related to local and regional production and innovation. Map and analyse regulatory landscapes, harmonization initiatives and regulatory reliance models relevant to medicines, diagnostics and vaccines in the Americas, including key international, regional and selected national initiatives. 2. Identify barriers, risks and opportunities from an access perspective Assess how regulatory frameworks, harmonization initiatives, regulatory practices, procurement approaches and production incentive mechanisms influence: Equitable access to quality‑assured medical products The feasibility, sustainability and scale‑up of local and regional production Market shaping dynamics, including systemic barriers and enablers affecting access, affordability, and availability of essential health technologies Identify how regulatory and market-related constraints translate into inequities in access, including delayed approvals, fragmented regulatory systems, and limited reliance mechanisms across countries. Drawing on MSF operational experience in the Americas, analyse where existing production and regulatory approaches fail or succeed in delivering affordable, quality‑assured and appropriate products to MSF settings and underserved populations. 3. Translate analysis into access-oriented frameworks and MSF positioning Develop and maintain an access-oriented policy and analytical framework for public and local/regional production and innovation, explicitly grounded in: Public health priorities Equity and affordability Quality assurance MSF operational and humanitarian needs In collaboration with MSF Access team produce periodic analytical updates, technical notes and internal briefs to inform MSF Access strategic discussions and decision-making. Provide technical pharmaceutical input to MSF positions, policy documents and advocacy strategies related to local and regional production, innovation, regulatory pathways, procurement approaches and regional collaboration mechanisms, ensuring these are grounded in evidence generated through the diagnostic and analytical work, and explicitly incorporating analysis of how regulatory and market dynamics affect equitable access, affordability and availability of essential medical products in MSF operational contexts. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics. MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated. We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process. Note: All offers of employment will be subject to reference checks, including Human Resources, and to appropriate screening checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her/their understanding of these selection procedures. Qualifications and Knowledge Degree in Pharmacy (mandatory). Solid knowledge of access to medicines and health technologies, including issues related to availability, affordability, quality and appropriateness. Understanding of local and regional production and innovation ecosystems, including public and private manufacturing models. Knowledge of regulatory systems for medicines, vaccines and diagnostics, including regulatory approval pathways, quality assurance, importation and exportation frameworks, and regulatory reliance or harmonization mechanisms. Familiarity with pharmaceutical policy, market dynamics and procurement is an asset. Basic understanding of intellectual property, licensing and technology transfer in the context of access to health products is an asset. Strong interest in public-health-driven and access-oriented approaches to local production and innovation. Commitment to MSF’s humanitarian principles and access-to-care mission. Professional Experience Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in pharmacy, pharmaceutical policy, access to medicines, regulatory affairs, public health analysis or related fields. Proven experience working in Latin American countries Experience related to local or regional production, regulation, procurement or access initiatives is a strong asset. Prior experience with MSF or other humanitarian, public health or non-profit organisation is an asset. Skills and Competencies Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to identify barriers, risks and opportunities. Excellent writing skills, including the ability to produce clear analytical briefs and technical notes for internal audiences. Ability to translate complex regulatory, production and policy issues into access-focused insights. Strong communication and collaboration skills in multidisciplinary and multicultural environments. Ability to work independently and autonomously, while coordinating closely with regional and international teams. Capacity to manage multiple analytical tasks and deliver outputs within agreed timelines. Proficiency in spoken and written English, Spanish, and Portuguese Frequent international travel. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Serving as the primary focal point between the shorebase and offshore assets, the coordinator will oversee warehousing, cargo handling, and vessel activities while supervising third-party service providers. Additionally, the role involves driving a strong safety culture, monitoring operational KPIs, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders to optimize efficiency during drilling, production, and subsea project phases. Responsibilities Responsible for the management, operational readiness and performance of BW Energy shorebase facilities, ensuring safe, efficient and reliable logistics support to offshore operations. Act as the primary logistics focal point between the shorebase and offshore assets, ensuring alignment of logistics priorities and operational requirements. Participate in daily operational meetings with the FPSO, Wellhead Platform, Drilling Rig and other project stakeholders to support the execution of Project activities. Ensure shorebase readiness to support drilling, production, subsea, construction and project activities throughout all project phases. Monitor and oversee all shorebase activities, including warehousing, yard operations, cargo handling, material staging, vessel support and logistics service providers. Ensure efficient planning and execution of shorebase logistics activities, supporting offshore operations through adequate allocation of resources and services. Monitor vessel activities during shorebase operations, including berth allocation, cargo operations, bunkering activities, water supply and coordination of additional port services when required. Supervise and monitor logistics service providers operating within the shorebase, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, operational requirements and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Monitor shorebase operational performance through KPIs, reports and operational controls, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. Support the monitoring of logistics contracts, service measurements, proformas and operational invoices related to shorebase activities. Promote and reinforce a strong safety culture across all shorebase operations and contractor activities. Ensure the proper implementation of emergency response plans, waste management procedures and oil spill contingency requirements related to onshore logistics activities. Identify and implement initiatives to improve operational efficiency, service quality and resource utilization. Ensure proper interface between shorebase operations, marine logistics, materials management, offshore units and logistics service providers. Monitor operational non-conformities, incidents and service deviations, ensuring appropriate reporting and follow-up of corrective actions. Support audits, inspections and compliance activities related to shorebase operations and logistics services. Ensure that relevant requirements of the Management System are used as the terms of reference for the activities controlled. Undertake training relevant to the position requirements. On-the-job training of colleagues and trainees. Assist in any other work specified by Department Head. Education Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Engineering, Maritime Studies or a related field is desirable. Experience Relevant experience in offshore logistics, shorebase operations, port operations or similar logistics leadership positions. Proven experience supporting offshore drilling, production, subsea, construction or development projects. Previous experience managing logistics service providers, shorebase contracts and offshore support operations. Knowledge Knowledge of offshore logistics, shorebase operations and port logistics. Knowledge of offshore drilling, production, subsea and construction support operations. Knowledge of logistics contracts, contractor management and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Knowledge of cargo handling, vessel support and shorebase logistics activities. Knowledge of HSE requirements applicable to logistics and shorebase operations. Experience with ERP systems, preferably IFS or equivalent systems. Advanced English communication skills, both written and spoken. Advanced Microsoft Excel knowledge. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Ticketing Stadium Configuration Coordinator
description: Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. The Position Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Stadium Configuration Manager the Ticketing Stadium Configuration Coordinator will help building and maintaining stadium seating maps for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working in close collaboration with the Configuration and Inventory team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for the management of ticketing inventory, seating plans and its maintenance in the Ticketing System, ensuring data accuracy throughout the planning phase and during the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Key Responsibilities Assist the team in building complete and accurate seating plans in the ticketing system for selected FIFA tournament venues in the host country. Assist in the implementation of all necessary seating information and configuration of spectator flows, price categories and seat allocations and carries out required updates. Maintain seating maps and configurations within the ticketing system on a day-to-day basis throughout all stages of FIFA tournaments and apply changes as required. Ensure data integrity and accuracy of all seating information and configuration. Carry out seat assignment processes in the ticketing system. Support the team to liaise with other functional areas in the planning of seating configuration and spectator flow for selected venues. Assess and analyze maps and plans of FIFA tournament venues to identify gaps and changes to be applied in the seating plans and configurations. Carry out onsite seat inspection visits to fully validate seating plans as built in the ticketing system with the actual venue seating. Evaluate outcomes of quality inspections and propose corrective measures. Support the overall management of ticketing inventory by conducting quality assurance measures for both ticket quotas and seat allocations. Support administration of allocations and additional ticket requests during the tournaments. Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events systems. Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events. Your Profile Education Bachelor's degree or equivalent level of education. Experience Strong professional experience. Experience working with ticketing systems (preferably Secutix). Experience in working with CAD technical drawings considered as a plus. Highly accurate and detail-oriented working style, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player. Skills & Competencies Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Sharepoint, Teams, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. Strong analytical skills, detail-oriented, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player. Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities. Skilled in facilitating collaboration between various business areas. Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones. Certifications & Requirements Willingness to travel to host cities. Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time. Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred. Languages: Fluent in English and Portuguese. Proficiency in additional languages is valued. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written). Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written). Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Marine Operator
description: Responsibility The Marine Operator shall be responsible for the running control of the stability of the Ship, its position and draught, and shall assist in the stability calculations. The Marine Operator is responsible for ensuring that own day-to-day activities and those of peers, are carried out in a safe and healthy manner and that the impact of such activities on the environment is within acceptable limits. Specific Duties Always keep informed as to where supply vessels, stand‑by vessels and helicopters are located, and shall keep records of this information in the ship’s logbook. Monitors on the cargo and ballast control panel. Monitors the inert gas pressure and oxygen content of cargo tanks. Monitors all marine alarms and carry actions in accordance with instructions. Check that ballast and cargo valves are function properly. The check will be logged in the vessel's logbook. Faults discovered with valves in the ballast and cargo system to be reported to the Lead Marine Operator. Carry out the duties and tasks as specified in the Emergency Response Plan. Follow‑up as required for PTW issuing, execution and closure of it. Ensure that stability calculations are made daily. Carry out such work as has been required by own superior and carry out duties as per documented Company Procedure, including administrative or operational activities. HSE Responsibility Responsible for maintaining a high degree of awareness. Lead by doing; setting an example for others. Observe and report any unsafe activities, conditions or situations. If you observe anything unsafe use the ‘Stop Work’ Policy. Qualifications General education, certificates and experience: Regarding units in navigation, this professional shall have an endorsement/seaman’s book complying with STCW rule II/1 and the title of Deck Officer. Regarding units in operation, this professional shall have an endorsement/seaman’s book complying with IMO Circ. A.1079(28) – item 6.4, as well as the title of Ballast Control Operator. Experience from tankers and/or mobile unit Fluent English #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Host Broadcast Operations Coordinator
description: Host Broadcast Operations Coordinator Department: Broadcast & Media Operations Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Reporting To: FERNANDA SIQUEIRA Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Host Broadcast Operations Coordinator supports the planning, coordination and delivery of Host Broadcast operations across all venues and central broadcast facilities, including the International Broadcast Coordination Centre (IBCC). Working under the direction of the Head of Broadcast and in alignment with the FIFA Zürich Project Lead – Senior Host Broadcast Production Manager, the role contributes to the implementation of broadcast operations and IBCC-related activities. The position supports coordination between FIFA project requirements, Host Broadcast Production delivery, and IBCC operations, ensuring aligned planning, consistent communication, and effective service delivery across all operational areas. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Support the planning, coordination and implementation of Host Broadcast operations across all FIFA Women's World Cup™ venues and central broadcast facilities. Assist the Head of Broadcast and FIFA Zürich Project Lead – Senior Host Broadcast Production Manager in coordinating operational planning, tracking project milestones and monitoring key deliverables. Support the Host Broadcast Operations Managers with venue planning activities, ensuring consistency of operational standards, documentation and implementation across all competition venues. Coordinate operational information, documentation and planning activities between FIFA departments, Host Broadcast partners and key service providers. Support the planning, coordination and operational readiness of the International Broadcast Coordination Centre (IBCC), including facilities, operational workflows, logistics and service delivery. Assist with the development and maintenance of IBCC operational documentation, layouts, operational procedures and planning schedules. Coordinate information relating to Host Broadcast and IBCC requirements, ensuring timely communication and alignment between all stakeholders. Support planning meetings, workshops, venue inspections and operational readiness activities, including preparation of agendas, minutes, action tracking and follow-up. Assist in monitoring project risks, dependencies and operational issues, escalating where appropriate and supporting the implementation of agreed actions. Contribute to the preparation of operational reports, presentations and management updates for internal and external stakeholders. Support planning for tournament-time operations, ensuring operational documentation, staffing plans and broadcast requirements are maintained and up to date. Work collaboratively across FIFA, FIFA27, Host Broadcaster and service providers to ensure an integrated approach to Host Broadcast and IBCC operations. Undertake additional operational duties as required to support the successful delivery of the FIFA Women's World Cup™. YOUR PROFILE Experience in broadcast, media and/or sports event environments University degree in broadcast, media, event management or a related field (or equivalent experience) Experience in project planning, broadcast operations, event operations, or coordination roles Experience supporting multi-disciplinary teams across functional areas such as accommodation, logistics, accreditation and travel Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail, particularly when working under pressure Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong administrative and reporting capabilities Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across multiple teams and levels Good problem-solving skills with the ability to use sound judgement and support operational decision-making Knowledge of local markets and cultural environments is an asset Familiarity with broadcast and or IBC/IBCC operations is a strong advantage Experience in major international sporting events is desirable Right to work in Brazil.
